The raw_customers table is an SCD2-style table with 230 rows for 200 distinct customers. 30 rows have is_current=False and valid_from 2023-06-01, and the other 200 have is_current=True. silver_customers does not filter on is_current, so the join duplicates transactions for the 30 customers that have history rows. That explains 5415 against 4699.

The fix is to keep only current rows in silver_customers. Each of the 200 customers has exactly one current row (200 current rows, 200 distinct customer_ids), so this gives one row per customer.

A possible complication is that region at transaction time might matter. The historical rows start at 2023-06-01 and the current rows at 2025-01-01. All transactions are in January 2026, which is after the current valid_from, so the current row applies.

The gold_region_daily SQL stays the same, because it is correct once the dimension has one row per customer.
